section_summary.extract_value: This section presents study hypotheses regarding the relationships between body appearance satisfaction, body appreciation, sexual function, and age in women. The authors hypothesize that women dissatisfied with their appearance will report lower sexual function and satisfaction with higher sexual distress, while those with greater body appreciation will experience better sexual outcomes. Additionally, they expect body appreciation to moderate the negative effects of aging on sexual distress and satisfaction.
